headlines.text: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms. Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.
Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?. The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump. The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.
Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry. The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.
Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king. King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.
Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China. Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated, CCTV reports.
Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone. Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge. Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.
Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration. The UK accuses Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

Tate brothers to remain in US jail as they fight extradition to UK. A federal judge denied them bail, saying the dual US-UK citizens' wealth and frequent international travel "constitute quintessential flight risks".
Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief. The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.
Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway. The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.
Russia's new jet-powered drones outpacing Ukraine's air defences with daily launches. The new models can travel at speeds of up to 300mph, faster than Ukraine's air defence interceptors.
Four key takeaways from  Republican midterms convention. The US president covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.
'People were trampling me': Philippine ferry fire survivor recalls narrow escape. A survivor has told the BBC of the chaos onboard as the ferry caught fire near the popular tourist spot of Coron.

Scientists say August was Earth's hottest month they've measured. The European climate service Copernicus said the Earth just sweltered through its hottest month on record in August. Scientists said the heat surge is mostly due to human-caused climate change.
UN peacekeepers give NPR a rare look behind Israeli lines. NPR accompanies UN peacekeepers behind Israeli lines as Israel expands its occupation of South Lebanon following a U.S.-brokered ceasefire.

'I'll never trust them again': Some Afghans who helped the U.S. post-9/11 regret it. Soon after the Sept. 11 attacks, the U.S. launched what would become a 20-year war in Afghanistan. Some Afghans who helped the U.S. prosecute that war regret it.

Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again. The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns. The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.

Iceland summons U.S. ambassador after Trump posts countries draped with American flag. Iceland summoned the U.S. ambassador after President Trump posted a map on Truth Social that showed the country, along with a number of other nations, covered with an American flag.
Kenya's foreign trader crackdown sparks fear among migrant communities. Kenya's president orders a crackdown on foreigners running small businesses, amid accusations of xenophobia.

Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms. A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.
Spain’s spy agency warned of mass crossings into Ceuta before border crisis. Declassified documents show Madrid and Morocco were warned of plans by migrants to breach the Ceuta border.
US states sue Trump over weakening of endangered species protections. Attorneys general from 20 states and Washington, DC, say the US government illegally rolled back landmark protections.
Republicans divided over Trump’s economy as RNC begins. Republican strategist Adolfo Franco and GOP adviser Rina Shah clash over Trump’s handling of the economy.
Trump administration proposes excluding certain immigrants from US census. The proposal aims to exclude some legal and undocumented immigrants from the count used to determine US House seats.
Iran war live: Iran media say ‘enemy’ projectiles hit Sirik areas. Tehran says ready for dialogue with nations in the region to 'foster mutual trust' and 'achieve sustainable security'.
US announces $45m in security funding, additional naval vessels for Ecuador. Secretary of State Rubio has hailed Ecuador as the US's 'most involved and aggressive partner' in the anti-drug fight.
Trump says the US-Iran war will end right after midterms. Seven months after launching the war on Iran, US President Donald Trump says it will end immediately after midterms.
Iran war looms over Trump at Republican midterm convention in Dallas. Trump supporters say he can rally Republican voters despite concerns over the unpopular war and rising prices.
Gauff beats Andreeva to reach US Open semifinals in comeback win. Coco Gauff sets up US Open semifinal with Elena Rybakina after saving two match points against Mirra Andreeva.
‘Everyone’s had their holidays ruined’: outrage after UK airport chaos. The UK's independent aerospace regulator has been instructed to review an air traffic control system outage on Tuesday.
US court denies Tate brothers’ bid to be released from Miami jail. A judge rules the brothers are a 'quintessential flight risk' due to their wealth and frequent international travel.
Misfiring Arsenal beat Napoli with Odegaard stunner in Champions League. Arsenal dominated play but needed a screamer from Martin Odegaard to seal three points in Napoli to open league phase.
Manchester United vs Sabah: UEFA Champions League – preview, team news. Man Utd have taken four points from their first four Premier League games, but Michael Carrick says team ready to rise.
Liverpool come back to beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 in Champions League opener. Marcos Llorente gives Atleti an early lead but Liverpool strike back through Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.
Trump says Iran war ‘will end immediately’ after US midterm elections. The president added the US is not looking to restart negotiations with Iran after the failure of previous ceasefires.

This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. Batteries just broke another record in the US. Battery installations hit a new record in the US in the second quarter of 2026. In total, 20.2 gigawatt-hours of new capacity came online, according to a new report. That’s enough to supply the daily electricity needs of about 700,000 homes. Understanding the thermal ceiling in portable power. Plug a phone into a modern charger and the first 10 minutes are impressive. The next 20 are not. This is not a defect. 4 groups caught using the same Chrome and Windows exploit kit. A patch gap and the hastened pace of AI-based vulnerability discovery are likely contributors.
Europe may finally have found a space entrepreneur who is meeting the moment. "We will not be relevant without a massive rocket at a massive cadence."
Six Chinese AI firms accused of aggressively copying US frontier models. US urges AI firms to ID, then secretly switch, Chinese users to less-capable models.
Apple's long-rumored foldable becomes reality with the $2,000 iPhone Duo. Apple's first foldable can be yours next month.
When it comes to Beatles references, scientists can't let it be. New study detects 3,200 references to Beatles song titles and lyrics in academic papers.
Lawsuit: Amazon refused to give pregnant workers bathroom breaks and chairs. Four women sue Amazon, say company denied basic accommodations and fired them.
Apple debuts $129 AirPods 5 with better noise cancellation and transparency mode. AirPods 5 with noise cancellation is cheaper than its predecessor.
Apple starts preorders for Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 with new Health Sensing System. New Apple Intelligence features, too.
The quick guide to fall vaccines and when you should get them. Here are the evidence-based recommendations and this year's vaccine rollout.
Apple's iPhone 18 Pro adds variable camera aperture and a more powerful chip. There's also a new thermal management system, reducing overheating.
Popular navigation apps unlikely to ditch Mercator maps despite UN resolution. UN-backed Equal Earth map has educational value but won’t alter navigation apps.
Anthropic researcher quits with a warning: Self-improving AI could "kill us all". "We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!"
Prime Video releases full trailer for Mike Flanagan's Carrie. "All I ever wanted was to go to school."
Google's AI genome system evaluates every possible one-base change. Most one-base changes to the human genome do nothing, but a few are significant.
NOAA is putting commercial fishing ahead of conservation. Critics say the new agenda could weaken science-based rules and marine protections.

The AI Researcher Who Just Quit Anthropic Says It’s ‘Crunch Time for Humanity’. Jacob Coxon talks to WIRED about the “mini Manhattan project” inside Anthropic, the problem with alignment, and why AI labs have just a few years left to make their systems safe.

San Francisco Orders Meta to Stop ‘Allowing’ AI Child Abuse Ads. The City Attorney’s Office has asked Meta to explain how the harmful ads repeatedly ran on Facebook and Instagram. The company claims the ads are not under the city’s jurisdiction.

A Year After Charlie Kirk’s Death, Turning Point Plans to Spend Big on the Midterms. Turning Point will spend tens of millions on ads and turnout, sources say, with a focus on New Hampshire, Arizona, and Nevada.

Everything Apple Announced: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch, AirPods 5. The company’s September event introduced Apple’s first ever foldable iPhone, along with new iPhone 18 Pro models, updates to the Apple Watch, some AirPods, and more advances to Siri AI.

Apple Doesn’t Want You to Worry About the New Apple Watch’s Listening Features. The new Apple Watch includes several “intelligent” listening features that have privacy and security baked in. But the protections can’t change the facts of what the tools do.
UK Lawmakers Are Freaking Out Over AI’s Summer of Chaos. As AI agents go rogue and fears of superintelligence grow, politicians are raising the alarm over its potential harm to human existence.

I Let an AI Agent Hack All My Gadgets—and I’d Do It Again. After I removed the safety guardrails from a powerful open-source model, it found vulnerabilities in my household devices and hacked into a PC. But it also told me how to make everything a lot more secure.

Apple Debuts the iPhone Duo, Its First Folding iPhone. The iPhone with a folding screen is the first radical redesign of Apple’s flagship handset in years. The iPhone Duo will cost $1,999 when it arrives in October.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4: Ceramic, Specs, Release Date. Apple’s latest smartwatches—the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4—get a faster chip, expanded health tracking, and new Siri capabilities. Plus, the ceramic finish is back.
You Can Now Destroy Flock Cameras for Cash in GTA V. A new GTA mod lets you smash and shoot Flock’s automatic license plate readers around the fictional Los Santos.

A Stealth Startup Thinks It Just Hacked the Memory Shortage. Kepler Computing claims a new approach to chip design—and a proprietary material—can help end the supply bottlenecks that have sent memory prices surging.

Apple Event Live Blog: Folding iPhone, Apple Watch Series 12, AirPods, and More. Get all the news when it happens, as our reporters bring you live updates from Apple Park, the company’s headquarters in Cupertino, California.

MS NOW Wants to Turn Its Viewers Into a Fandom. The cable news network’s president, Rebecca Kutler, wants to leverage its massive online and TV audience to create a fan community. First up: letting you chat with Rachel Maddow.
Lyft Sees a Future for Its Drivers in a Driverless World: Servicing Waymos. A team-up with Waymo in Nashville has former Lyft drivers maintaining self-driving cars. What’s next?

A US Census Report on Noncitizen Voting Used Bad Data to Reach Faulty Conclusions. Trump has touted a recent Census report. WIRED found grave flaws in its analysis and the process behind it, and confirmed the identity of several of its authors—among them a one-time DOGE affiliate.

Ex-NFL cheerleader battles former gubernatorial aide in tight GOP primary race. Elaine Pelino and Aaron Guckian are locked in a Rhode Island Republican primary too close to call as the GOP eyes a historically blue state.

Drake Maye's terrible decision gifts Seahawks opening night win as Patriots left stunned to start NFL season. Josh Jobe's acrobatic end-zone interception sealed the Seattle Seahawks' 13-10 win, as Drake Maye threw three picks in the NFL season opener.

Trump makes stunning first-of-its-kind cash promise in bid to rally GOP voters at Dallas midterm convention. President Donald Trump promised a $5,000 "Trump dividend" to every adult citizen if Republicans keep Congress at the GOP midterm convention.

Patriots' AJ Brown exits NFL season opener against Seahawks, ruled out with ankle injury. New England Patriots newcomer A.J. Brown walked to the locker room wearing one cleat after receiving medical attention on the field in Week 1.

Fetterman teases where his true loyalty lies after surprise appearance at GOP convention. Senate Democrat John Fetterman drew a hard line after introducing Dave McCormick at the Republican National Committee's midterm convention.

NBA star Jaylen Brown says in ridiculous interview he's an influencer, not an entertainer for fans. Jaylen Brown told Mahershala Ali he refuses to be seen as just an entertainer, adding to a long history of quotes that critics call tone-deaf vanity.

EXCLUSIVE: 25 years after 9/11, ICE says more than 2K known or suspected terrorists have been deported. ICE arrested over 2,150 known or suspected terrorists and deported more than 2,000 since Trump took office, DHS says ahead of the 9/11 anniversary.

Researcher who departed AI role over fears of racing into extinction says people are 'begging' for regulation. Jacob Coxon, the Anthropic researcher who left the company over fears the technology could take over the human race, shared his experience with Fox News.

US Open winner Andy Roddick defends late finishes amid criticism after Ben Shelton-Carlos Alcaraz thriller. Andy Roddick defended the US Open's late-night scheduling on his "Served" podcast after Ben Shelton's epic win over Carlos Alcaraz ended at 3:33 a.m.

Talarico says he 'missed the mark' as he backtracks on controversial woke statements. James Talarico now backs banning transgender surgeries for minors and opposing trans athletes in girls' sports as the Texas Senate race heats up.

George W Bush recalls moment with Derek Jeter before nerve-wracking pitch at Yankee Stadium after 9/11. Former President George W. Bush recalls throwing the ceremonial first pitch at Yankee Stadium weeks after the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.

US forces obliterate suspected 'narco-terrorist' vessel in lethal Eastern Pacific strike, killing 3. A U.S. military strike destroyed a suspected drug-smuggling vessel in the Eastern Pacific, killing three alleged narco-terrorists, officials said.

NFL's Week 1 9/11 tribute begins in Seattle with wild guitar solo during national anthem. The Seattle Seahawks honored 9/11's 25th anniversary with a moment of silence before Pearl Jam's Mike McCready delivered a grunge-style anthem.

Bryce Underwood addresses Kyle Whittingham's comments about remaining starting QB at Michigan. Michigan Wolverines QB Bryce Underwood feigned ignorance when asked about Kyle Whittingham questioning his starting job after the Week 1 win.

Dem senator delivers surprise video at Republican convention backing McCormick. John Fetterman's surprise video at the GOP convention praised Trump and Dave McCormick while rejecting what he called Democratic "extremes and socialism."

Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention. The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

Conductor Julian Wachner receives suspended sentence for possession of child sex abuse material. The formerly prominent, widely recorded conductor was sentenced Wednesday to nearly six years of probation for five counts of possession of child sex abuse material in Indianapolis.

Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone. New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

Special education head at Education Department abruptly resigns. The leader of the Education Department's special education office told employees she is resigning after less than four months in the role and as the agency overall is morphing and shrinking.

Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight. Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy. Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?. Bangladesh has seen over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases of measles this year. The death toll among children just surpassed 1,000. How are officials trying to bring the outbreak under control?

Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps. A Trump census proposal would stop asking about race and exclude millions of U.S. residents from a count that the 14th Amendment says must include the "whole number of persons in each state."

European Central Bank hikes interest rates to 2.5% as policymakers see risk of higher inflation, weaker growth. The central bank is contending with rising prices, the consequences of the U.S.-Iran war and surging government borrowing costs.
Trump's $1 trillion-plus 'dividend' plan meets immediate bipartisan pushback. Such a payout could cost more than $1 trillion and is likely to face legal obstacles.

'Extinction' warnings ramp up as more OpenAI, Anthropic researchers join calls for an AI slowdown. There is growing concern globally about the capability of AI, following numerous cyberattacks and security incidents in recent months by rogue models

U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war. Oil prices remain elevated amid worries that escalating tensions in the Middle East could further exacerbate supply disruptions

Apple makes biggest change to iPhone release cadence in 7 years in Ternus' first showcase as CEO. In John Ternus' first launch event as CEO, Apple announced its first foldable phone and the iPhone 18 Pro.

Amazon backs Ariane with rocket launch orders as Europe battles to close its space gap. The deal hands the continent's space industry a commercial boost as governments push for greater sovereign capabilities.
Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected. The producer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

Trump warns Tehran over Pickaxe Mountain activity; U.S.-Iran exchange attacks on ships near Hormuz. U.S. President Donald Trump has urged Iran "not to get cute" over activity at a suspected nuclear site on Pickaxe Mountain.

Investors seek hedges as midterms and geopolitical risks threaten market calm. Investors are starting to seek more protection against stock market swings as a historically volatile period for markets approaches.
UBS CEO flags investor complacency as geopolitical and economic risks mount. The UBS top boss cautioned that investors face an increasingly complicated environment given multiple headwinds.

The world's highest paid leader is set for a 64% pay rise. Here's how others compare. Wong announced ministerial salaries will be adjusted upwards after 15 years, with his annual pay package rising to 3.6 million Singapore dollars

Ryanair CEO says to brace for a 'significant uplift' in airfares as oil prices soar. Ryanair's CEO warned airfare prices may see significant hikes as the surging cost of jet fuel continues to squeeze the airline industry.
World’s largest contract chipmaker TSMC sees August revenue surge over 53% to record high. TSMC reported monthly sales revenue for August on Thursday.

'Saved the day': How China helped keep the lid on oil price surge as Iran war disrupted supplies. China's crude stockpiling and subsequent pullback on purchases since the war erupted in late February has helped the world avoid a deeper energy crisis.

Trump says oil and gas prices won't fall until 'right after' midterm election. President Donald Trump said energy prices that have been elevated due to the Iran war will not come down until after the midterm elections.
